meta.title: DDD Presentation Professional Direction
meta.summary: Image-first visual references for a professional Domain-Driven Design presentation system.
meta.business: Introduction to Domain-Driven Design knowledge sharing
meta.goal: Professional live presentation, presenter console, audience display, reader notes, mobile, and print

mustPreserve: single visual reference image per tile

items.title: Strategy Room Context Wall
items.caption: A product strategy workshop wall with clean context-map shapes and calm executive staging.
items.tone: Product strategy workshop, calm and decisive
items.motif: workshop wall, bounded-context cards, thin connector lines
items.prompt: Single editorial photograph of a refined product strategy workshop wall, off-white paper cards arranged as abstract bounded contexts with thin ink-navy connector lines, no readable writing, no logos, no UI labels, warm paper surface, compact and orderly composition, subtle muted teal pin accents, professional engineering education tone, realistic room light, 16:9 composition.

items.title: Ink Navy Stage Paper
items.caption: A premium slide-stage material direction: navy frame, warm paper, thin rules.
items.motif: navy stage edge, paper sheet, fine grid and rules
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of a warm paper presentation sheet resting on an ink-navy stage surface, fine hairline grid and rule details without readable text, compact technical spacing, subtle shadows, executive education deck mood, no logos, no people, no collage, 16:9 overhead composition.

items.title: Thin-Rule Service Map
items.caption: A service-map visual language for marketplace checkout without literal labels.
items.motif: service blueprint, connected rectangles, payment flow abstraction
items.prompt: Single composed scene of an abstract service blueprint drawn with thin ink-navy rules on warm neutral paper, connected unlabeled rectangles suggesting marketplace checkout and payment flow, one darker focal node, no readable words, no logos, crisp product-strategy workshop quality, photographed from a slight angle, 16:9.

items.title: Presenter Console Detail
items.caption: A restrained control-surface reference for speaker notes and slide previews.
items.motif: small preview panels, notes surface, dark chrome
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of a professional presenter control surface on a laptop-like dark frame, abstract slide preview panels and warm paper notes area, no readable text, no real UI labels, compact sans-like blocks only as texture, ink navy chrome, soft studio lighting, product education context, 16:9.

items.title: Domain Model Tabletop
items.caption: A tabletop artifact direction for modeling sessions: cards, boundaries, and quiet materiality.
items.motif: tabletop cards, boundary tape, workshop hands absent
items.prompt: Single editorial photograph of a clean tabletop domain modeling setup, unlabeled warm paper cards grouped inside thin navy boundary lines, a few neutral markers and ruler-like tools, no readable text, no hands, no logos, calm product strategy workshop atmosphere, high taste B2B presentation reference, 16:9.

items.title: Bounded Context Architectural Lines
items.caption: A more architectural diagram reference with strong spacing and crisp boundaries.
items.motif: architectural drafting, context blocks, sparse connectors
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of an architectural drafting sheet with abstract bounded-context blocks, precise thin navy lines, sparse connectors, clean negative space, no readable labels or measurements, warm off-white paper, professional technical education mood, photographed flat with slight paper texture, 16:9.

items.title: Marketplace Flow Material Study
items.caption: A tactile representation of one checkout becoming many fulfillment paths.
items.motif: one central path splitting into grouped paths
items.prompt: Single composed material detail of thin navy thread or linework on warm paper, one central route splitting into several neatly grouped routes, abstractly suggesting one checkout and multiple order groups without labels, small muted teal anchor point, no readable text, no collage, refined strategy workshop image, 16:9 macro-overhead composition.

items.title: Compact Control Tokens
items.caption: A UI-system texture reference for compact controls without real interface content.
items.motif: small controls, counters, stage rail, technical rhythm
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of abstract compact control tokens on an ink-navy surface, small pill-like buttons and counters represented only by simple shapes, no readable text, no logos, no actual app UI, warm paper card nearby, precise spacing, professional presentation-control mood, 16:9.

items.title: Editorial Book Desk
items.caption: A reference for the book slide: serious learning material without literal book-cover text.
items.motif: technical books, paper tabs, navy desk
items.prompt: Single editorial photograph of three unlabeled technical books on an ink-navy desk, warm paper tabs and thin rule bookmarks, no readable titles, no logos, refined education-deck mood, soft directional light, compact arrangement with generous negative space, 16:9.

items.title: Diagram-First Teaching Wall
items.caption: A teaching visual where the diagram is the hero and the text is intentionally absent.
items.motif: large unlabeled diagram, teacher-ready wall, controlled hierarchy
items.prompt: Single editorial photograph of a large off-white teaching wall with one clean abstract diagram made of thin navy lines and rounded rectangles, no readable writing, no presenter visible, a small muted teal highlight shape, professional workshop stage lighting, calm and sophisticated B2B learning atmosphere, 16:9.

items.title: Reader Notes Paper System
items.caption: A handout/notes visual direction with dense but readable paper hierarchy.
items.motif: paper handout, note rail, diagram margins
items.prompt: Single overhead visual reference image of a professional printed handout system, warm paper pages with abstract blocks and thin navy margin rules, no readable text, no logos, subtle note rail and diagram placeholders, compact editorial hierarchy, product-engineering training mood, 16:9.

items.title: Mobile Reading Surface
items.caption: A responsive review mood: compact, legible, and still presentation-grade.
items.motif: small screen silhouette, paper cards, navy surround
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of a small-screen reading surface abstracted as a warm paper card inside an ink-navy frame, compact blocks and diagram shapes with no readable text, no logos, no real device brand, polished responsive presentation mood, clean shadows, 16:9.
